purpose: one model that works with camera + LiDAR, camera only and LiDAR only; per training sample the image or the points are dropped (p = 0.3 each, never both), so the decoder learns the no_image / no_points tokens and the camera-anchored translation fallback
based_on: m-boxhead-v3-000 (padded box head, pseudo-GT v3 labels, main split 75 % BEDLAM + all real, 15k steps, batch 2048)
prerequisites: Helma checkout at origin/main after the push of the dropout commit (git rev-parse HEAD == origin/main)
no code change on Helma needed; the data staging is the standard STAGE_DIRS set

val_sources: waymo_val_img, sloper4d_test_img, threedpw_test_img (image only: points removed)
waymo_val_pts, sloper4d_test_pts, threedpw_test_pts (points only: image removed)
watch.metrics: val/<source>/mpjpe, pa_mpjpe, transl_err, map in outputs/m-modality-dropout-000/metrics.jsonl and val_*.json
watch.reference: m-boxhead-v3-000: Waymo 60.4 mm, transl 0.074 m, mAP 0.64 (both sensors); v2-abl-image-only / v2-abl-lidar-only are the fixed-gate single-sensor ablations
watch.success: both-sensor rows within a few mm of m-boxhead-v3; _pts rows near the lidar-only ablation; _img rows near the image-only ablation; no row diverging (nan / > 300 mm) after step 3000

on_done: nothing automatic; report the nine val rows against the references; the board needs a Debug/Main row for the run (build_scoreboard.py) if it should appear
eval_cost_note: nine val sources at 6000 samples each, every 1000 steps; if an eval takes longer than 5 min lower data.val_max_samples via EXTRA_SET
prepared: 2026-10-16 by the development session (lidar-bedlam); the monitoring session starts it
